name: Payment Obligation
definition: Obligation for the debtor to pay the creditor an amount of cash.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Underlying reason for the payment obligation

RemittanceDeliveryMethod.name: Remittance Delivery Method
RemittanceDeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies the method to be used by the first agent (debtor agent in the case of a credit transfer, creditor agent in the case of a direct debit) to deliver the remittance advice information, which may be sent separately from the payment instruction.

Percentage.name: Percentage
Percentage.definition: Maximum amount that a financial institution guarantees to pay for a specific commercial trade, expressed as a percentage of the purchase order net amount.

MaximumAmount.name: Maximum Amount
MaximumAmount.definition: Maximum amount that a financial institution guarantees to pay for a specific commercial trade.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Date at which the obligation will expire. For instance, it is the transaction authorisation deadline to complete a payment by card.

ApplicableLaw.name: Applicable Law
ApplicableLaw.definition: Country of which the law governs the payment obligation.

PaymentOffset.name: Payment Offset
PaymentOffset.definition: Fulfilment of a payment obligation through a payment and its execution. It is derived from the association between Obligation and Obligation fulfillment.

AssociatedDocument.name: Associated Document
AssociatedDocument.definition: Specifies the referred document/transaction, eg, invoice or credit note.

RemittanceLocation.name: Remittance Location
RemittanceLocation.definition: Address to which the first agent is to send the remittance information.

Interest.name: Interest
Interest.definition: Process which calculates the interest to be paid. It may also specify the interest charged on instalment.

CommercialTrade.name: Commercial Trade
CommercialTrade.definition: Commercial trade which creates the payment obligation.

PaymentSourceBuyIn.name: Payment Source Buy In
PaymentSourceBuyIn.definition: Buy-in process which created the payment obligation.

RelatedCorporateAction.name: Related Corporate Action
RelatedCorporateAction.definition: Corporate action processes which are the source of the payment obligation.

RelatedCollateralMovement.name: Related Collateral Movement
RelatedCollateralMovement.definition: Collateral movement which is the source of the obligation.

PaymentSourceUndertakingDemand.name: Payment Source Undertaking Demand
PaymentSourceUndertakingDemand.definition: Undertaking demand which is the source of a payment obligation.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a payment obligation and played by a party at that step in a payment flow.

ExecutedSecuritiesTrade.name: Executed Securities Trade
ExecutedSecuritiesTrade.definition: Securities trade which created a payment flow.

RelatedAccountClosingTerms.name: Related Account Closing Terms
RelatedAccountClosingTerms.definition: Contract which authorises the transfer of funds resulting in a payment obligation.

PaymentSourcePortfolioTransfer.name: Payment Source Portfolio Transfer
PaymentSourcePortfolioTransfer.definition: The PaymentObligation that specifies the payment resulting from charges due by one party to another.

PaymentSourceCurrencyOption.name: Payment Source Currency Option
PaymentSourceCurrencyOption.definition: The PaymentObligation that specifies the amount of the premium paid by the buyer of the option and its settlement place.

ExchangeRateInformation.name: Exchange Rate Information
ExchangeRateInformation.definition: Foreign exchange trade which is the source of the payment.

Dividend.name: Dividend
Dividend.definition: Dividend for which payment terms are specified.

RepurchaseAgreement.name: Repurchase Agreement
RepurchaseAgreement.definition: Repurchase agreement which covers the delivery of cash by the buyer.

RelatedAssignment.name: Related Assignment
RelatedAssignment.definition: Assignment which contains one or more payment obligations.

BankingTransaction.name: Banking Transaction
BankingTransaction.definition: Transaction executed by the client of a financial institution from/to the account serviced by the financial institution, such as mortgage payment.

PaymentTerms.name: Payment Terms
PaymentTerms.definition: Specifies the payment terms of the obligation.
